Round 111 (C-R110-01) is implemented and waiting for C. Pressing Escape to return the floating video no longer drops keyboard focus onto the page body. In real Chromium at 1440×900, after Escape focus lands on ▶, and the next Enter adds no clip. None of the browser acceptance rows are claimed by me, and the backlog item is not marked done.

**Changed files** (exactly 2 modified + 2 new; HEAD is still `832fee2`; the 545 frozen files are unchanged)
- `app/components/arrangement/StudioWorkspace.tsx` (`2acbb082…`, +22 lines): only the four allowed parts.
  - A small helper that finds ▶.
  - A ref that records the pending rescue.
  - Inside `returnFloatingVideo`, only when the library was opened for the video: before anything unmounts, record whether focus is inside the library.
  - A layout effect that, if that was recorded and focus fell to the body, focuses ▶ with `preventScroll: true`.
  - The Escape and Enter branches, JSX, classes, labels and test IDs are untouched.
- `app/lib/arrangement/__tests__/library-video-return-focus.test.tsx` (`4a490a9f…`): 10 new tests, VR0–VR7. VR3 is split into 3a and 3b, and VR4b runs in jsdom.
- `docs/implementation/2026/quarter-IV/096-studio-video-return-library-focus.md` (`08708763…`): new doc.
- `docs/implementation/2026/quarter-IV/095-studio-library-toggle-focus.md` (`7ee01e79…`): only line 4 changed, to say round 110 is C PASS and published in `832fee2`.

**Fail-before** (on B's snapshot, in a scratch copy): VR1, VR2, VR3a, VR3b and VR7 fail; VR0, VR4, VR4b, VR5 and VR6 pass. This matches B's expectation.

**Mutations** (the unmutated control passes 10/10 before and after):

| Mutation | Failing tests |
|---|---|
| m1 (never record) | VR1, VR2, VR3a, VR3b, VR7 |
| m2 (always record) | VR0, VR4b |
| m3 (m2 + no body check) | VR0, VR4, VR4b |
| m4 (helper returns ◀) | VR1, VR2, VR3a, VR3b, VR7 |
| m5 (no `preventScroll`) | VR7 |

Two results go beyond B's list, both explained in the report. m2 also breaks VR4b: focus on the float's ✕ gets moved to ▶ before the video dock can return it to ⤢. m4 also breaks VR3a/b, which depend on the rescue.

**Checks run**
- `npm run typecheck`: exit 0.
- `npm run lint`: exit 0, with 0 diagnostics in my files (218 warnings exist elsewhere in the repo).
- `biome check` on my two code files: clean, without `--write`.
- Targeted vitest: 8 files, 153/153 passed. The grep found 6 files, and I added `render-budget` and `self-disabling-focus`.
- I did not run the full suite, `npm run verify` or the build; those belong to the gate.

**Chromium probe at 1440×900:** both repro variants (◀ and the selected option) end with focus on ▶ after Escape. Enter then opens the library with focus on ◀, the video stays docked and 0 clips are added. The first attempt timed out on the first page load after the edit; the retry passed.

**Code review:** the code-reviewer subagent scored it 9/10 with no Critical, High or Medium findings. It worked without a shell, so it read the four changed regions directly rather than running `git diff` or the tests; my own diff confirms there are no other changes.
- Low, kept: VR0 asserts that Enter on the body adds one clip. B's task requires that assertion, but it depends on the open user question B-R107-ENTER-ON-BODY. If that answer changes, VR0 has to change with it; this is flagged for B.
- Low, kept: focus on the timeline and the video drag handle has no test of its own. Those sit outside the library like Play and ✕, which VR4/VR4b cover.
- Low, kept: a layout-mocking helper copied as-is from the frozen neighbouring test is fragile.
- Two minor style points are also kept; their reasons are in the report.
- Its architecture note is in the report word for word: the same armed-ref focus-rescue pattern now appears three times, and it suggests extracting a shared hook as a separate bounded task. That is a proposal for B or root; I did not act on it.

**Gaps:** I did not run the probe at 1280×720, and I did not measure VR-SCROLL or VR-OUTSIDE in a browser; those are C's rows. The 161 MB scratch copy may not survive to the next job, so I copied the small mutation evidence to `a-round-111/mut-evidence/`. The probes used fresh incognito contexts and never wrote `a-browse.json`.

**Next for C:** every row in §2 of the current task, from VR-HAZARD through SOURCE-UNCHANGED, plus re-running m1–m3 with its own mutation strings. If C uses B's m2 (arm regardless of where focus is), expect VR4b to fail as well as VR0.
